ae25849b.task: Perform bounded black-box reconnaissance and attack-surface mapping for https://httpbin.org. Enumerate reachable paths, methods, parameters, forms, API behaviors, redirects, content types, and any client-side entry points. Use browser/crawler/proxy-assisted mapping as needed, but keep crawls bounded and high-signal. Do not file vulnerability reports from raw anomalies alone. Deliver a concise completion report with endpoint inventory, notable input surfaces, and recommended next validation targets.

8e7f2675.task: Profile https://httpbin.org as a black-box target without exploit testing. Identify technologies, headers, allowed methods, API conventions, endpoint families, encoding/redirect behaviors, and any features likely to affect downstream validation such as CORS, cookies, auth hints, rate limiting, file upload, or URL-fetch style behavior.
